items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Pat Rodkin as the manager of the person the interviewee is discussing (likely Zutty Singleton himself, referred to as 'Zuttie' or 'he'), but the interviewee does not describe a direct personal relationship with Pat Rodkin in this excerpt.

ctx.x: Well I loved California so much that I turned them down.

And he was taking gigs by himself. But Pat Rodkin who was his manager, he still loved Zuttie you know. And he told me, Marge, can't you talk to him? Can't you do something with him? I say, now you know he won't leave California.

So, they called Zuttie for a picture and Zuttie accepted it for three hundred and some dollars, some decent or something. And Pat called to find out, he had heard that Zuttie was, they were going to get Zuttie in this band. And he said, Marge what are they going to pay him? I said three hundred and fifty something. He said, is he crazy? He said, well I'm going to take it on myself. I'm going to handle that. He got about a thousand dollars for Zuttie.
